name: AI Jingle Maker
original_description:
Describe the jingle you need, for a radio station, a podcast, a DJ set, an event or a shop, and AI Jingle Maker builds a draft from its licensed catalogue of about 970 intros, music beds and outros: three sounds that fit, a short script in your words, and a voice chosen from 99 voices in up to 74 languages.

The draft card in the conversation lets you hear each sound, swap any of them, edit the script, change the voice and play a watermarked preview of the whole jingle. When you are happy, ask to render: the clean MP3 and WAV are produced and saved to your AI Jingle Maker account.

Drafting, swapping sounds, editing the script and watermarked previews work without an account. Rendering the clean files uses your existing AI Jingle Maker account, so you connect it the first time you render.

Made for radio hosts, podcasters, DJs, small businesses and anyone who needs a professional-sounding ident in minutes. Jingles are short (about 10 to 30 seconds); this is not a music or song generator.
